name: pi-inspect-context
description: A bounded, read-only Pi extension for locating relevant repository context.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --types node src/adapter.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run build && npm run test:typescript && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:node: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/packet.test.ts test/adapter.test.ts test/package.test.mjs test/benchmark.test.mjs test/benchmark-gate.test.mjs test/session-metrics.test.mjs test/replay.test.mjs
scripts.test:typescript: npm run build:typescript && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/worker/*.test.mjs test/tool.test.ts
